crossRefs.note: Yahweh himself is who goes before you. He will be with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you. Don’t be afraid.…
Haven’t I commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid. Don’t be dismayed, for Yahweh your God is with you…
Yahweh is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? Yahweh is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid?
The wicked flee when no one pursues; but the righteous are as bold as a lion.
“I, even I, am he who comforts you. Who are you, that you are afraid of man who shall die, and of the son of man who…
Have you forgotten Yahweh your Maker, who stretched out the heavens, and laid the foundations of the earth? Do you live…
“Whom have you dreaded and feared, so that you lie, and have not remembered me, nor laid it to your heart? Haven’t I…
